summary: OpenAI shipped a patch release (v0.0.7) of the gpt-oss reference repo containing Metal backend performance optimizations (GPU-side sampling, fused QKV kernel, tuned threadgroup sizes, optimized prefill matmul) and minor eval/tool bugfixes.

practices.reason: The release describes concrete, reproducible kernel-level optimizations (GPU sampling, fused QKV projection, tuned matmul) for the Metal inference backend that a team running gpt-oss on Apple Silicon could pull in directly.
practices.quote: Metal: Adding optimized dense matmul kernel to optimize prefill perf by @ibahmed-oai in https://github.com/openai/gpt-oss/pull/183
